rationale: Build on the current Bigram64+QK2.0 winner with the next high-priority Mac-mini idea category: shared-heavy, unique-light depth. This patch reuses a two-block encoder stem across all encoder passes while keeping the full decoder tail, bigram head, and exact quant-aware endgame intact. That cuts unique parameters and quantized artifact pressure without adding compile churn or extra per-step compute, which is a better fit for a 600-second M4 budget than another tail-only micro-ablation.
title: Shared Encoder Stem On Bigram64 Best
